notes: Account summary: mid-sized fintech focusing on real-time trade surveillance and downstream analytics. Need deterministic inference for alerting pipelines.

Primary ask: Dedicated capacity with hard throughput guarantees during market hours (08:00–17:30 ET) plus autoscale for offhours burst. Interested in reserved GPU planning and SLA that covers p50/p95 latency and sustained throughput.
Performance targets: 30–50ms p50 for short prompts (<=64 tokens), p95 <= 200ms; sustained throughput 4k TPS during market open (mix: 60% embeddings/rerank, 30% short chat, 10% long-summary).

Autoscale requirements: strict scale-up <120s for sudden load spikes (market open), scale-down policy must avoid thrash during oscillations — prefer hysteresis + minimum warm-pool of pre-warmed instances for top 20% peak workloads.
Warm pool/keep-warm: they want explicit warm-pool sizing guidance: propose warm pool of 10% of peak GPUs, pre-warm time SLAs per model (BFloat16 7B ~45s, 70B int8 ~90s).

Queueing/backpressure: require deterministic queueing behavior — bounded queue length, priority lane for high-severity alerts, and configurable drop vs delay policy. Client quote: 'We cannot allow alerting latency to exceed 300ms or we get false negatives.'

Routing/fallback: must support automatic fallback to smaller quantized variants with clear loss-of-quality bounds. Blocker: legal pushback on 'automatic downgrade' clause — needs explicit acceptance flow in SLA.
Cost sensitivity: medium — willing to pay premium for guaranteed latency during trading hours, but expect Optimize recommendations to reduce unit cost (smart batching + prefix cache).
Security/compliance: strict — must enforce customer-managed KMS, detailed audit logs for each inference request, and in-region only residency for EU subset of customers.

POC notes: stress test showed healthy p50, but p95 regression from cold starts; Diego recommended adding model-level warm pools and reducing cold-start path by keeping KV caches warm for top-20 prompts.

Action items captured: run 48hr soak on reserved pool with production traffic; produce warm-pool sizing doc + recommended scale latency curves; update SLA draft to include fallback opt-in and liability caps.
